articles.seoTitle: Costco Q4 FY2026 Earnings Call: What It Said About AI
articles.description: Costco's CFO said AI search traffic grew triple digits for a second quarter and converts best of any source. Every AI statement from the call, with sources.
articles.summary: Costco reported its fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 on September 24, 2026. On the call, CFO [[person:gary-millerchip]] said traffic from AI search grew triple digits for the second quarter in a row and converts better than any other traffic to costco.com. This note collects every AI and digital statement from the call, highlighted in green, each with its source.

So they mentioned all these things. So again, this is going to affect local other warehouses.
So it's always good to know what's coming, what's planning, and also they are including four in Europe as well. It's not everything in US. But this is always good to know what's coming ahead.

For example, if 33 are opening, if you see, there will be a market share split in these locations, it can impact directly or indirectly the possible real estate as well. It can impact the gas stations as well.
Talking about the gas stations and pharmacy. If you see a gas, a record year, the share, the share of US member household buying gas reached an all-time high. Costco estimated it saved $3.2 billion.
So, again, it's going to impact the gas stations pharmaceuticals travels and like merchandise like the Costco sales and number of things, and it can impact the local businesses around that as well.
So this is the reason why we need to read and study about earnings calls in the relevance of what we're doing as an AI researchers, or SEO, GEO, SEO, AEO, whatever we call, basically, it's always good to analyze the different data sources in order to understand what's coming and be prepared.
And we need to be well knowledge regarding the business because ultimately our job is to impact the business growth, either in the levels of revenue or traffic or visibility whatever it is, but you need to understand what's coming, what's impacting directly and indirectly.

sections.title: What did Costco say about AI search?

blocks.text: ==Traffic to Costco's site from AI search grew at a triple-digit rate for the second consecutive quarter, and it still has the highest conversion rate of all traffic to the site.==[^2] ==The channel is young: the CFO said it is growing from a low base compared with Costco's other channels, while AI keeps gaining influence on how members search for products.==[^2]

==Sales that start in AI search are led by appliances and consumer electronics, the same categories that lead Costco's e-commerce overall.==[^2] ==The Costco membership itself is among the top items that AI searches lead to, which the CFO read as a sign of how members value it.==[^2]

Rupesh Parikh of Oppenheimer asked how Costco is positioned for agentic commerce.[^2] ==The CFO's answer: not agentic commerce at the moment. What Costco sees is members using AI as a tool to search for products as they plan what to buy.==[^2]
==Sales that originate from searches on the large language models are growing at triple-digit rates. He named the tools: Gemini, Anthropic and OpenAI.==[^2]

==Costco does no paid digital advertising. The CFO described AI as a neutral environment where Costco's value and quality can show up transparently, helped by a curated range of items its buyers vet personally.==[^2]
==The work behind it: Costco's teams are working with the large language models on how to clean up and update its product data and product pages, so its value keeps showing up accurately.==[^2]

items: ==Digitally enabled comparable sales grew 19.5% in the quarter (19.8% excluding currency) and 20.9% for the full year.==[^1]
==Digitally enabled sales, including third-party delivery, exceeded $33 billion for the year, up more than 20%.==[^2]
==Total site and app traffic was up 30%.==[^2]
==Personalization, through product placements and emails, grew sales at a triple-digit rate, and 10% of costco.com orders now include a personalized item.==[^2]
==Costco is discontinuing Costco Next, its extended marketplace, and moving its most popular items and brands into the main app and website.==[^2]

sections.title: What should search and AI teams take from this?

blocks.text: This part is my read, not Costco's words.

items: AI answers are now a sales channel that a retailer of Costco's size measures: it tracks the traffic, the conversion rate and the products sold.
The lever Costco named is product data and product pages. That is work search teams already own.
A brand with no paid digital ads can still win in AI answers, if its value is visible in its own data.
Earnings calls are free, dated and attributable. Read them for every company in your market, and log what they say about AI each quarter.

items: Excluding the one-time tariff benefit, net income grew 12.3% and earnings per share 12.4%.[^2]
Fiscal 2026 net income was $9.226 billion, $20.76 per diluted share.[^1]
Gross margin was 11.02%, down 11 basis points, or up 20 basis points excluding gas. The LIFO charge was $152 million, against $43 million a year earlier.[^2]
SG&A was 8.94% of sales, 27 basis points better than a year ago. The tax rate was 25.2%.[^2]
Capital spending was $2.21 billion in Q4 and $6.4 billion for fiscal 2026, with about $7.5 billion planned for fiscal 2027.[^2]
Q4 was the last quarter to benefit from the membership fee increase.[^2]

sections.title: What else did Costco cover on the call?

items: Warehouses: 12 opened in Q4, 10 of them new US buildings, and 28 in fiscal 2026, three of them relocations, for 939 in total.[^1][^2] Costco plans 33 openings in fiscal 2027, five of them relocations, including 4 in Europe, 5 in Canada and 1 in Mexico, and new US markets such as Buffalo, New York and Lawrence, Kansas.[^2]
Gas: a record year. The share of US member households buying gas reached an all-time high, and Costco estimates it saved members over $3.2 billion.[^2]
Pharmacy: sales grew nearly 20%, helped by GLP-1 and fertility programs, and Costco has a new partnership with SCAN to develop Medicare Advantage benefits.[^2]
Travel: Costco sent over 750,000 members on cruises, up 16%.[^2]
Members: the member base under 40 has grown nearly 60% since COVID and is now more than a quarter of all members.[^2]

Tariff refunds: Costco received $184 million in Q4, $174 million in refunds plus $10 million in interest, a little more than a third of what it expects.[^2] Part of the refunds was reinvested in increased member value.[^1]

Merchandise: non-foods comparable sales grew mid- to high-single digits, led by gold and jewelry and home furnishings. Fresh grew mid-single digits, led by bakery and meat, with in-house pastries up over 100%.[^2]
Kirkland Signature price cuts: walnuts from $13.79 to $9.99, and Colombian whole bean coffee from $21.99 to $19.99.[^2]
Ancillary businesses: comparable sales up in the high 20s, with gas up in the mid-30s. Inflation stayed in the low single digits.[^2]
Next update: September sales results on October 7, 2026.[^2]
